summary: Minimal fail-closed Task sandbox scanner fix for an independent Host issuer private 0700 directory and idempotent external audit symlink file targets; no privilege or Lease policy widening.

components.disposition: Reuse the existing signed Task Lease, protected audit roots and Seatbelt/bwrap policies. Continue scanning all public roots and reject hardlink/symlink aliases; accept verified regular-file audit targets idempotently and deny their exact file path.

The first fix revealed a second existing issue: recursive audit scanner returned external regular-file symlink targets and then rejected those same paths on the second pass.
Five targeted regression tests and 91 related tests pass; real Mac protected-root Seatbelt profile compilation now passes without changing private permissions.
